title: Military members saw football-field-size triangular craft
summary: David Grusch tells of Military members saw football-field-size triangular craft, about c. 2019-2021 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I remember sort of interviewing some military members that saw some really profound stuff like, you know, large, you know, triangular crafts, you know, football field size that, you know, hovered over them.
